mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id,due_date,action_id FROM occurrences WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId} AND due_date=#{dueDate}
SELECT o.schedule_id,o.due_date,o.action_id FROM occurrences o JOIN schedules s ON s.id=o.schedule_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND o.action_id=#{actionId}
SELECT o.schedule_id,o.due_date,o.action_id FROM occurrences o JOIN schedules s ON s.id=o.schedule_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY o.due_date DESC,o.action_id
SELECT schedule_id,due_date,action_id FROM occurrences WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId} AND due_date BETWEEN #{first} AND #{last} ORDER BY due_date LIMIT 1
